adjudication: The critics do not disagree on the load-bearing mathematics. Killer Finding 1 — the central claim that <|B|^4>/<|B|^2>^2 = O(1) for the Mobius mollifier is false and inverted, with m2 diverging like (theta*log T)^2 and Theorem parts (ii)-(iv) false as stated — is independently derived by the referee (same sign-coherence/4^omega(n) mechanism, same conclusion: certificate tends to -1, vacuous). A confirmed false central input meets the refutation standard unless the repair rescues the direction's purpose. It does not: the referee's bounded-variance repair yields an honest O(theta^2) gain that the referee's own Finding 2 shows is strictly dominated by window-widening throughout Regime I, so repaired M1/M2 beat no existing constant and M2's outcome is the pre-registered no-go. That leaves Regime II as the sole affirmative core, and there killer Finding 3 is decisive and unrebutted: the binding off-diagonal at total length XM^2 > T is the P_X x P_X term with Lambda-coefficients on BOTH long variables — genuine Hardy-Littlewood prime-pair correlations (PCC alpha > 1, the canon wall the map localizes at O1_bound -> prop_PP -> tr2); BCHB/Bettin-Chandee-Radziwill technology handles divisor-type long variables from the approximate functional equation, and the mu-average runs only over short variables. The referee asserts evaluability without addressing this coefficient-type mismatch, and their repair 3 quietly converts M3 into an unproven conjecture — a known-hard problem in disguise presented as the prize. On the Track-B specification: B1 reuses the identical inertia/rank-trace generator on W(b*f, b*g), a reweighted restriction of the same Weil cone — an S4 failure; its S1 separation (M4) is real but redundant with the program's recorded DH input-level failure. One killer claim is overruled: Finding 2's O(1/log T) supremum over all weights is too strong (the resonator attains O(theta^2)), but the operative kill survives via domination. Refuted as a Track-B direction; the salvage (no-go theorem, weighted-block Lean lemmas, corrected numerics, honestly framed separation) is real and should be harvested.
mandatory_repairs: Convert the route into a theorem-level no-go: prove the trace-gain vs Frobenius-variance trade-off showing two-moment Weil-Gram certificates gain at most O(theta^2) from any bounded-variance weight (window-dominated in Regime I), and record the (theta*log T)^2 fourth-moment divergence for Mobius-type weights as a lemma.

Any resubmitted Regime II claim must state explicitly how the Lambda x Lambda off-diagonal at total polynomial length > T is evaluated or bounded without Hardy-Littlewood/PCC alpha>1 input, or be declared conjectural and priced via the LP-ceiling template before work begins.

Merge the sound weight-agnostic instruments (20-line 2x2 signature lemma, configuration-free weighted rank-trace certificate) into RHLinalg as standalone contributions, decoupled from any constant-improvement claim.
Reframe M4 honestly as formalizing a known input-level separation (drop the 'no antecedent' claim), and order it first.

Re-aim Experiment A to admissible parameters (theta <= 0.2 equivalent, M <= 5 at 10^4 zeros or 10^5-10^6 zeros from Odlyzko tables) to measure the inflation ratio against the (log M)^2 law; fix Experiment B to compare at matched total support.

Any successor proposal seeking S4 must construct a Weil-form analogue whose atoms carry zeta'(rho)-type mass (a CGG-style damping target) rather than reweighting flat-mass atoms — the one open structural question this refutation leaves.
killer_findings_upheld: Finding 1 (fatal): the mu-mollifier fourth-moment ratio diverges like (log M)^2, m2 blows up, Theorem parts (ii)-(iv) are false as stated, and the certificate tends to -1 — independently confirmed by the referee's own computation.

Finding 3 (major): Regime II's binding off-diagonal sums are Lambda x Lambda prime-pair correlations (HL/PCC alpha>1 strength), not the divisor-coefficient shifted convolutions that Deshouillers-Iwaniec/BCHB/BCR technology evaluates; the claimed technology transfer is a disguised prime-pair assumption — unrebutted by the referee.
Finding 4 (minor): the DH/Epstein separation is real but not new leverage; the unmollified engine already fails for DH at input level per the program's own record.
Finding 5 (minor): Regime I's 'twisted data outside the bandwidth-one class' is a repackaging — every ingredient is evaluated from the identical PNT + Montgomery-Vaughan input window.

Finding 6 (minor): both experiments as designed cannot decide their advertised go/no-go signals — Experiment A's parameter grid is far outside every admissible regime (independently confirmed by referee Finding 4) and Experiment B has an unaddressed matched-support confounder.
killer_findings_overruled: Finding 2's blanket quantitative claim that sup over ALL real Dirichlet-polynomial weights equals the unmollified value + O(1/log T): overruled as stated. The referee's log-weighted prime resonator (c_p proportional to log p with bounded n_tail) attains a net gain of O(theta^2) independent of log T in the same quadratic gain/penalty model; the killer's O(1/log T) bound applies only to Mobius-profile directions forced by demanding an order-theta trace gain. The operative conclusion — M2/M3's targets (0.6725, 0.68183) are unreachable and no existing constant is beaten in Regime I — still stands, but via the referee's window-domination argument (O(theta^2) mollifier gain strictly below the O(theta) window gain), not via vanishing of the mollifier gain.
